Package com.example.gitcat_events.core.model

Class Event

java.lang.Object
com.example.gitcat_events.core.model.Event
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Event extends Object implements Serializable
Represents an event that users can register for. Events have a capacity, optional waitlist size, dates via calendar objects, and a boolean for if geolocation is required.

  • Constructor Details

    • Event

      public Event()
      No-arg constructor for Firebase

    • Event

      public Event(String name, String description, int capacity, @Nullable Integer maxWaitListSize, String poster, Calendar registrationStartDate, Calendar raffleDate, Calendar eventDate, Boolean geoLocationRequired)
      Constructs an event object with the following parameters:
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the event (cannot be null)
      description - a brief and concise description of the event
      capacity - the maximum number of people that can attend the event (must be positive)
      maxWaitListSize - the maximum size of waitlist (should be positive, can be null)
      poster - the poster of an event (Base64 encoded string, cannot be null)
      registrationStartDate - the date when registration opens
      raffleDate - the date of the raffle for the event (when registration closes)
      eventDate - the date of the event taking place
      geoLocationRequired - a boolean value to determine if geolocation is required for the event
